punchline: A lawsuit threat, a parody and a slogan: none of the replies measured anything.
thirty_sec: Silent Spring ran in The New Yorker in June 1962 and appeared as a book on 27 September. In between came a Velsicol legal threat, Monsanto's parody The Desolate Year and a White-Stevens warning of a return to the Dark Ages.
question: Which criticism of your work answered what you said, and which answered a louder version?
key_contrast: A reply to your claim is different from a reply to a bigger, easier version of it.
